$comment: Advisories the release gate may pass despite severity >= high. Each entry MUST say why it is safe and MUST expire, so acceptance is re-reviewed rather than forgotten. scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails on any high/critical advisory not listed here, and on any listed entry past its expiry.

accepted.reason: DoS via malformed JXL/HEIF images. Reached only through metro (the React Native BUILD-TIME bundler), which parses images from this repository's own assets, never attacker-supplied input, and ships nothing to users. The fix is image-size 2.x, a semver-major that metro 0.84 (pinned by Expo 56) does not accept.
DoS via malformed ICNS images. Same build-time-only reachability and same blocked fix path as GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq.

RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements (a forged signature can pass). Reached only through @expo/cli (the developer CLI) and @expo/code-signing-certificates, which sign development manifests with the developer's own key and verify only that self-made signature or self-signed certificates; no third-party signature is verified. Not in the app bundle (P3.9 scan) and not an API dependency. No patched release exists (<= 1.4.0 affected, 1.4.0 is the latest). Short expiry: re-check for a fix.
